metadata.description: Marketplace for the dotfiles-sync plugin: hooks and a skill that sync the Claude Code, Git, SSH, project, VS Code, and GitHub CLI config across machines, encrypted.

plugins.name: dotfiles-sync
plugins.description: Keep your dotfiles in sync across machines: the global Claude Code config, the Git and SSH config, the CLAUDE.md and .claude/ files your projects keep out of Git, and the VS Code and GitHub CLI settings, encrypted with age in a private Git repo through chezmoi. Syncs on its own at session start and end; a skill handles setup, new machines, and conflicts.
